('''AHL''') is an Indian [[real estate]] development company established in 1986 and headquartered in [[New Delhi]], India. The firm is a real estate company that was recognized by [[Forbes]] as Asia's 200 Best Under A Billion in 2010 and 2011.{{cite news|title=O.P. Gupta, Chairman, Ashiana Housing|url=http://www.mindyourbusiness.in/articles/1002542/op-gupta-chairman-ashiana-housing|access-date=19 October 2015|publisher=Mind your Business|archive-date=15 September 2015|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150915152551/http://www.mindyourbusiness.in/articles/1002542/op-gupta-chairman-ashiana-housing|url-status=dead}} ==History== Ashiana Housing Ltd.{{cite news|title=Can Ashiana Housing replicate its success outside North India |url=http://forbesindia.com/article/work-in-progress/can-ashiana-housing-replicate-its-success-outside-north-india/39711/1|access-date=19 October 2015|work=Forbes India Magazine|date=3 March 2015}} is involved in [[Middle class|middle]] to [[Upper middle class|upper-middle]] income residential housing projects in satellite cities and towns in India– around industrial hubs – predominantly along the Delhi-Mumbai industrial corridor being promoted by the [[Government of India]]. Its residential [[real estate development]] projects range from apartments to group housing projects. In addition, it also develops limited retail and commercial properties, including hotels as well as retirement homes for senior citizens.{{Cite news|url=https://www.livemint.com/Money/dvN4ue8SccGtAB0vRXLthI/Whats-the-real-cost-of-retirement-homes.html|title=Money|last=Vishwanathan|first=Vivina|date=2013-08-27|work=livemint.com/|access-date=2018-11-14}} The company was incorporated on 25 June 1986, under the Companies Act, 1956, as Ashiana Housing & Finance (India) Limited. Subsequently, the name of the company was changed to its present name in the year 2007.{{cite web | url=https://www.ndtv.com/business/stock/ashiana-housing-ltd_ashiana/reports | title=Ashiana Housing: Reports, Company History, Directors Report, Chairman's Speech, Auditors Report of Ashiana Housing - NDTV }} As of 31 December 2014, the company completed 24 residential developments and 6 commercial developments, aggregating 10.74 million square feet of saleable area. ==Sponsorships and Joint Ventures== On 4 January 2010, Ashiana announced a joint venture with the Manglam group in Jaipur for the development of 31 acres of land. The Ashiana Manglam partnership built several projects in Jaipur.{{cite news|title=Ashiana Housing Q4 net up by 57 per cent at Rs 26.65 crore|url=http://articles.economictimes.indiatimes.com/2012-06-03/news/32006538_1_net-profit-total-income-manglam-group|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20151013025333/http://articles.economictimes.indiatimes.com/2012-06-03/news/32006538_1_net-profit-total-income-manglam-group|url-status=dead|archive-date=13 October 2015|access-date=19 October 2015|publisher=Economic Times|date=3 Jun 2012}}{{cite web|title=Ashiana & Mangalam Group launch new residential project in Jaipur|url=http://www.projectstoday.com/News/Ashiana--Mangalam-Group-launch-new-residential-project-in-Jaipur|website=Projects Today|access-date=19 October 2015}} Ashiana Housing raised Rs 200 crore from Goldman Sachs and [[Creador]] by way of Qualified Institutional Placement of its equity shares in February 2015.{{cite news|title=Ashiana Housing raises Rs 200 cr via QIP|url=http://www.business-standard.com/article/pti-stories/ashiana-housing-raises-rs-200-cr-via-qip-115021001055_1.html|access-date=19 October 2015|publisher=Business Standard|date=10 February 2015}}{{cite news|title=Creador invests $16.2m in Indian housing developer Ashiana|url=https://www.altassets.net/private-equity-news/by-news-type/deal-news/creador-invests-16-2m-in-indian-housing-developer-ashiana.html|access-date=19 October 2015|publisher=AltAssets|date=11 Feb 2015}} In June 2015, Ashiana joined Escapade Real Estate, a part of Arihant Foundations, to launch a housing project called "Ashiana Shubham"{{cite web|title=Project Ashiana Shubham in Chennai by Ashiana|url=https://property.sulekha.com/ashiana-shubham-in-maraimalai-nagar-chennai}} for senior living and normal housing, in Chennai.{{cite news|title=Ashiana Housing, Escapade Real Estate to offer retirement home in Chennai|url=http://www.business-standard.com/article/companies/ashiana-housing-escapade-real-estate-to-offer-retirement-home-in-chennai-115061300441_1.html|access-date=19 October 2015|publisher=Business Standard|date=14 June 2015}} In July 2015, Ashiana signed a partnership deal with Shriram Properties to develop a housing project in [[Kolkata]]. Through this partnership with Bengal Shriram Hi-Tech City Pvt. Ltd. (a group company of Shriram Properties Ltd.), the company will develop senior living as well as regular housing on 19.72 acres of land.{{cite news|title=Ashiana Housing enters into development agreement|url=http://www.sharekhan.com/stock-market/news/Ashiana-Housing-enters-into-devlopment-a/2E5A156F-12BB-415B-AD60-945924E0CFD0/AllNews/163/News.htm|access-date=19 October 2015|agency=ShareKhan|publisher=Sharekhan|date=14 July 2015}} ==Financial Summary== During the fiscal year 2014–15, Ashiana's net profit doubled to Rs 46.49 crore from Rs 21.86 crore (the previous fiscal year). Income from operations increased to Rs 142.70 crore from Rs 110.65 crore. The company claims to have raised Rs 200 crore in 2015 from investors through Qualified Institutional Placement. In the fiscal year 2012–13, the company posted a profit after tax of Rs. 33.2 crore. The company reported a 61% increase in revenues (sales & other income) in 2011–12 over the previous financial year (2010–11).{{cite web|title=Ashiana Housing Ltd (ASFI:Natl India)|url=https://www.bloomberg.com/research/stocks/financials/financials.asp?ticker=ASFI:IN|website=Bloomberg Business|access-date=19 October 2015}} ==References== {{Reflist}} ==External links== * {{Official website|https://www.ashianahousing.com/}} [[Category:Real estate companies of India]] [[Category:Real estate companies established in 1986]] [[Category:Companies based in New Delhi]] [[Category:Companies listed on the National Stock Exchange of India]] [[Category:Companies listed on the Bombay Stock Exchange]]
extract: Ashiana Housing Ltd. (AHL) is an Indian real estate development company established in 1986 and headquartered in New Delhi, India. The firm is a real estate company that was recognized by Forbes as Asia's 200 Best Under A Billion in 2010 and 2011.
